text:
Sam Chen: kicking off HALO POC perf benchmark — customer target = sustained 350 qps for short conversations, p95 < 200ms. want multi-quant comparisons (fp16, ptq int8, awq/int8) and one cold-start run. smoke today, soak tomorrow. can eng confirm capacity and test corpus?
Priya Nair: got it. we can run on dedicated pool (gpus in us-west2). pls upload a 1k message sample set or tell us to re-use the anonymized support-corpus. also need to know whether we should pin to the v1.2 model or test latest v1.3-compatible weights.
Sam Chen: use anonymized support-corpus (i'll drop link). pin to v1.2 for baseline then v1.3 for perf delta. also customer asked about encryption-in-transit+at-rest — KMS will be required for private deploys.
Liam O'Connor: perf engine ok. i'll run three sweeps: fp16 baseline, quant-ptq int8, and awq int8. testing plan: 5m ramp, 20m steady at 350 qps, 5m ramp down. capture p50/p95/p99, tail traces, mem/GPU util, and kv-cache hit rate.
Jordan Kim: adding ops notes — we need 10% headroom so we'll cap at 315 sustained for dedicated infra smoke to avoid noisy neighbors. we'll also enable prefix caching for repeated prompts to simulate production.
ops-bot: deploy started: cluster/dedicated/us-west2/slotset-12 — image=redwood-runtime:2026-03-22-rc3. status=provisioning.
Priya Nair: quick ask on metrics TTL — sales wants a PDF summary with heatmaps and cost delta by quant. can you include estimated cost per 1M tokens for each variant?
Liam O'Connor: yes — we'll export CSV with cost calc: tokens/s * sec * instance_rate. rough numbers ahead of run: fp16 ~ $X/1M, ptq-int8 ~ ~0.6x cost, awq-int8 ~0.45-0.55x but watch quality regressions on long contexts.
Sam Chen: quality check: include a 50-case eval set and flag any >5% accuracy drop or hallucination increase vs baseline. if regression too big, call it out in the summary.
Jordan Kim: security blocker: customer security questionnaire flagged 'key zeroing on teardown' and 'HSM-backed KMS' — engineering, can we confirm we have HSM option in private?
Priya Nair: legal is already looping in SRE + security for the HSM/KMS Qs. for now note that Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS in our private deploy. we'll attach a short note in the PDF.
Liam O'Connor: smoke results: fp16 baseline p95=188ms, ptq-int8 p95=210ms (some jitter), awq-int8 p95=175ms but p99 tail spikes at 450ms on cold cache. GPU util averages: fp16 58%, ptq 45%, awq 35%. attaching raw CSV (will export).
Sam Chen: awesome — can you produce the PDF by EOD with: summary bullets, heatmaps, CSVs, cost table, and the security note? i'll forward to the customer and call out the recommended config (awq-int8 + prefix caching + canary roll).
Priya Nair: noted. next steps: 1) Liam attach CSVs + sample eval diff, 2) Jordan confirm infra cap and headroom numbers in doc, 3) I'll draft security appendix. target PDF 18:00 PT.
Liam O'Connor: uploading CSVs now -> /artifacts/halo/poc/3921002468/results.csv and /artifacts/halo/poc/3921002468/eval_diff.json. I'll also include the run command we used: \n```\nloadtest --target 350 --ramp 5m --steady 20m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant awq-int8 --cache-prefix --output results.csv\n```
Jordan Kim: ops note: if they want multi-az failover we'll need contract addendum for SLA and cross-region egress cost. flagging to Sam.
Sam Chen: thanks team. i'll chase the security answers and follow up with contract ask if they push multi-az. :thumbsup:
